title: Adaptive Dual-Teacher Distillation with Subnetwork Rectification for Bridging Semantic Gaps in Black-Box Domain Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2603.22908v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Assuming that neither source data nor source model parameters are accessible, black-box domain adaptation (BBDA) represents a highly practical yet challenging setting, where transferable knowledge is limited to the predictions of a black-box source model. Existing approaches exploit such knowledge via pseudo-label refinement or by leveraging vision-language models (ViLs), but they often fail to reconcile the inherent discrepancy between task-specific knowledge from black-box models and language-aligned semantic priors of ViLs, resulting in suboptimal integration and degraded adaptation performance. To address this challenge, we propose adaptive Dual-Teacher Distillation with Subnetwork Rectification (DDSR), a framework that explicitly reconciles these complementary yet inconsistent knowledge sources. translated_title: 面向黑盒域自适应语义鸿沟弥合的自适应双教师蒸馏与子网络校正方法
translated_abstract: 在源数据和源模型参数均不可访问的假设下，黑盒域自适应（BBDA）代表了一个非常实用但极具挑战性的场景，其中可迁移的知识仅限于黑盒源模型的预测输出。现有方法通过伪标签细化或借助视觉-语言模型（ViLs）来利用此类知识，但它们往往无法调和来自黑盒模型的任务特定知识与ViL的语言对齐语义先验之间固有的差异，导致次优的知识整合和下降的自适应性能。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了自适应双教师蒸馏与子网络校正方法（DDSR），这是一个显式调和这些互补但不一致的知识来源的框架。DDSR采用自适应预测融合策略来整合来自黑盒源模型和ViL的预测，从而生成……
tldr: 提出了一种自适应双教师蒸馏框架DDSR，通过自适应预测融合与子网络校正策略，调和黑盒源模型的任务特定知识与视觉-语言模型的语义先验之间的差异，有效弥合了黑盒域自适应中的语义鸿沟。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes DDSR, an adaptive dual-teacher distillation framework with subnetwork rectification that reconciles task-specific knowledge from black-box source models with language-aligned semantic priors of vision-language models, effectively bridging semantic gaps in black-box domain adaptation.
